# GuitarEasy

> GuitarEasy is a browser-based alphaTex guitar tablature reader and MIDI player. Paste or upload
> alphaTex notation and read/play it with the [alphaTab](https://www.alphatab.net/) engine —
> nothing is uploaded to a server; parsing and MIDI playback happen entirely in the browser.

GuitarEasy renders alphaTex (`.atex`/`.tex`/`.txt`) guitar tablature, plays it back with an
animated cursor and built-in MIDI synth, and keeps uploaded scores in the browser's local storage.
It ships with example scores (*Canon in D*, *Game of Thrones Theme*, *Spanish Romance*) and
supports system/light/dark colour modes.

## Docs

- [Source and README](https://github.com/ShaojieJiang/guitareasy): features, local development,
  project structure.
- [MCP server](https://guitareasy.app/mcp): a remote [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server
  at `/mcp` for uploading/downloading `.atex` files and playing a score back inline inside a
  compatible MCP host (Claude.ai, Claude Desktop) via an MCP Apps UI resource. See
  [`mcp/README.md`](https://github.com/ShaojieJiang/guitareasy/blob/main/mcp/README.md) for the
  tool list (`upload_atex`, `download_atex`, `list_atex_files`, `play_atex`).

## Notes

- alphaTex is a plain-text guitar tablature notation format; see
  [alphaTab's alphaTex documentation](https://www.alphatab.net/docs/alphatex) for its syntax.
- GuitarEasy does not require an account and does not upload files by default — the MCP server
  above is the only network-facing storage, and only when a client explicitly calls its tools.
